items.t: Globant announces Converge 2026: an edition about reinvention in the AI-Native Era, with Glob.AI at the center
items.sum: Globant (NYSE: GLOB), a global company focused on driving enterprise reinvention through AI, today announced Globant Converge 2026, its flagship virtual event, which will take place on December 10. items.t: Wedbush Assumes Globant at Outperform, Announces Price Target of $49
items.sum: Wedbush analyst Moshe Katri assumes Globant (NYSE:GLOB) with a Outperform rating and announces Price Target of $49.

items.t: Globant Stock Has The Bull Case Changed After Lower Earnings Guidance
items.sum: Globant reported third quarter 2026 results with sales of US$611.14 million and net income of US$13.92 million, and guided both fourth quarter and full year 2026 revenues to be slightly lower year on year. items.t: Globant (GLOB) Stock Is Up 12.4% Today Without Company News
items.sum: On Tuesday, Nov. 24, shares rose 12.4% without company-specific news while the S&P 500 fell 1.2%.

items.t: UBS Maintains Neutral on Globant, Raises Price Target to $47
items.sum: UBS analyst Leonardo Olmos maintains Globant (NYSE:GLOB) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $43 to $47.
